lines.text: Your parents land in two hours. Nothing goes wrong today. Nothing.
Nothing. Absolutely nothing. Shake on it?
Why is the cat offering handshakes again?
He only does that when he has gotten away with something.
Okay. Step one. Your mother's favorite mug comes down from the shelf.
Where is the mug, Dale?
It was on the counter. Right on the edge. Like it wanted adventure.
Mugs are free spirits. You can't hold them.
It's in four pieces under the fridge.
I did not put it on the edge!
Great talk, everyone. Handshake.
Fine. Step two. The birthday cake. Your mother turns seventy tonight.
Why is there a little path through the frosting?
That is a tiny path. That is a path for someone very short.
Interesting. Dale, check your nose.
Why is there frosting on my nose?
You fell asleep on the couch at noon. Things happen to sleeping men.
Dale. It says happy birthday, Lin.
Her name is Linda!
And now, briefly, it is Lin. Very modern.
Handshake, cookie jar?
I do not have hands. That is why he picks me.
Step three. The roast chicken. The one thing we cannot replace.
I left it resting on the stove. Where is the chicken?
It was resting. Maybe it's resting somewhere else.
Chickens leave, Renee. It is the circle of life.
It was cooked! It had no legs left to leave on!
Then it was very determined.
There is a trail of gravy going under the table.
That's interesting, because Dale's socks are covered in gravy.
When did you put gravy on my socks?
Witness statement. A large orange gentleman dragged a chicken under that table.
Cookie jar. Remember who knocked your lid off last spring? And who did not tell?
Witness statement withdrawn. Nobody saw anything. Least of all me.
Beautiful. Handshake.
Renee, it's him. Look at his face. He's smiling in a suit.
Dale, he's a cat. Cats don't plan things.
Okay. Everyone stop. I have to tell you something.
I burned the chicken this morning. It was black. It was charcoal with wings.
What?
So I asked Tofu to make it disappear. And I ordered a new one.
We had a deal. I take the chicken. Dale takes the blame.
And the cake? And the mug?
The cake was me. I was stressed. I ate the D and the A.
The mug was me. Free spirit. Some things you just have to push.
So I've been framed by my wife and a cat in a tie.
Partner. Handshake.
Partner. Handshake.
Okay. Well. I have something to tell you too.
My parents aren't coming tonight. They canceled yesterday.
You let me cook for two days?
I wanted the chicken. I've been watching this whole thing very quietly.
Dale. I underestimated you.
Handshake?
Absolutely not. Nobody here gets away with anything ever again.
